sourceDesc.p: Original album forms part of the Thomas Carlyle Papers Collection at Columbia University Rare Book and Manuscript Library

div.p: Captioned by TC / “ These things I mark, mournfully, as a kind of duty,—this evg Monday 7 Octr 1867—T.C. ” / this album with its laid-in addenda includes 52 images

figure.head: Carlyle Photograph Albums, Album 2, Page 1
figure.caption: Photograph of seated Elizabeth Countess of Pepoli, with written inscription reading, "These things I mark, mournfully, as a kind of duty - this evg. Monday 7 Octb. 1867. - T. C." Photograph labeled: "Elizth Countess Pepoli (once Elizth Fergus of Kirkcaldy)."
